name: Charanga flute
desc: Cuban charanga-style flute in high Eb major over the montuno: short syncopated riff-fills locked to the 2-3 clave with rapid-alternation trills at phrase peaks, answering the piano guajeo call-and-response; peak climbs to the whistling top register with double-time descents.

root.doc: semitone offset from Eb major home

code.full: note("<[~ ~ [bb5 g5] [ab5 f5]] [[g5 eb5] ~ ~ [~ bb4]] [c5 [eb5 f5] g5 ~] [[bb5 ab5] g5 [f5 eb5] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_flute").attack(.01).decay(.25).sustain(.35).release(.15).shape(.25).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.85, ${cut}*1.15).slow(16)).clip(.88).gain(${gain}).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(16)).room(.35).delay(.2).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.22).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[~ [g5 ab5 g5 ab5] [bb5 g5] [ab5 f5]] [[g5 eb5] [f5 g5] ~ [bb4 c5]] [c5 [eb5 f5] [g5 ab5 g5 ab5] bb5] [[eb6 c6] [bb5 ab5] [g5 f5] [eb5 ~]]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_flute").attack(.008).decay(.22).sustain(.3).release(.12).shape(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.3).slow(8)).clip(.85).gain(${gain}), note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ [g4,bb4]]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_flute").decay(.2).sustain(.1).lpf(${cut}*.8).gain(${gain}*.45).pan(.62)).room(.32).delay(.18).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.2).orbit(5).play()
